nom: REUZEL TAT BUFF Gentle Exfoliating Wash

aspects.libelle: Works well paired with shine spray or hydro buff

extraits.texte: The Buff Exfoliating Wash I bought for the first time recently. It doesn't dry my skin out and the Bamboo grains are super gentle which is a plus for me. I use a lot of Reuzel products and will definitely be adding Buff Exfoliating Wash to my list of must-haves :).

The exfoliating buff wash is an absolute game changer to my tattoo care routine. Applying just a little bit in the shower definitely helps me remove all that dead skin that just lingers after a long day working my day to day job. Highly recommend it !
Product works great, smells good. Seems to exfoliate as it should and isn't too rough.
Exfoliation works perfectly smell great leaves skin feel awesome

reserve: The reviews focus almost entirely on tattoo-care use and general product satisfaction, with no reviewer specifying their skin type or a skin concern, so segmentation by skin type or concern cannot be produced from this set.
